title: Modality-specific reactive and predictive responses in the human superior colliculus
title_zh: 人类上丘特定模态的反应性和预测性响应
abstract: Inspired by recent theoretical work emphasizing predictive neural processing, we tested whether a midbrain structure for multimodal sensory integration-the superior colliculus-would show predictive responses to both visual and somatosensory stimulation. A multi-stage experimental design allowed us to test predictive activity in the human superior colliculus while 7-Tesla functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) allowed us to map its sensory response across superior colliculus layers (N = 80). As expected from non-human animal work, visual and somatosensory stimulation elicited distinct depth-dependent responses. We also observed a predictive response: these same modality-specific and depth-dependent effects occurred during task periods preceding direct stimulation, when sensorimotor input was identical between visual and somatosensory conditions. Further analyses rule out cross-trial carryover and show corresponding effects in the thalamic sensory nuclei. Here our results confirm that, in humans, the superior colliculus is sensitive to both visual and somatosensory input, and they demonstrate that it carries predictive signals for upcoming sensory events.
abstract_zh: 受近期强调预测性神经处理的理论工作启发，我们测试了一个负责多模态感官整合的中脑结构——上丘——是否会对视觉和体感刺激产生预测性响应。多阶段实验设计使我们能够在人类上丘中测试预测性活动，同时使用7特斯拉功能磁共振成像（fMRI）对上丘各层的感官响应进行映射（N = 80）。正如预期的那样，基于非人类动物研究，视觉和体感刺激引起了不同的深层依赖性响应。我们还观察到了预测性响应：在直接刺激期间之前的任务期间，出现了相同的模态特异性和深层依赖性效应，此时传感器运动输入在视觉和体感条件之间是相同的。进一步的分析排除了跨试验携带过，并在感官丘核中显示出相应的效应。在这里，我们的结果确认，在人类中，上丘对视觉和体感输入均敏感，并表明它携带即将到来的感官事件的预测信号。
